item.title: WATCH | Stefano Filletti: ‘We have to think outside the box to hold AI accountable’
item.description: How do we hold AI accountable? That is the burning question that weighed on Stefano Filletti’s mind before he was chosen to head the Council of Europe’s working group on AI that is trying to find the answers to that question. He sits down with Matthew Farrugia and enters a rabbit hole on the most controversial new technology of our age
